$ <HUB>/bin/config-check --bogus
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
The config pipeline's check (docs/design/new-user.md 3.7): validates every config file at once.

  config-check            validate the config in the working tree
  config-check --staged   validate the **index** (what is about to be committed; called by githooks/pre-commit and the config
                          repo's githooks/config/pre-commit). Passes at once when the index changes no config file.
                          A shared working tree may hold someone else's half-edited files, so, as test-gate does, the index
                          is exported to a temp directory and validated there with AGENT_HUB_ROOT pointing at it.

What it validates:
  hub.json           contracts/hub.v1.schema.json (minischema) + unknown top-level keys (except explanation keys starting
                     with _): a mistyped key (e.g. "assitant") is not silently ignored
  projects/          registry.refresh()'s validation (schema, duplicate names, after: pointing at jobs that exist, run
                     resolvable…)
  models.env         must not exist (since 10-29 model settings live in hub.json llm.points)
  mirror-list.txt    one git remote per line
  services.tsv       every row has as many columns as the header, labels are unique
  schedule.yaml      readable, job names unique (the old format, during the switch)

When it passes, the tree it validated is recorded in the git directory's config-check-passed (githooks/post-commit uses it to
catch commits that skipped the gate).


$ <HUB>/bin/config-check
[exit 0]
--- stdout
config-check: the config is all valid
--- stderr
